title: Parts of Speech and Word Formation — Level 10 — Final challenge

tags.kisi-kisi: Parts of Speech and Word Formation

items.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about the speech contest.

visual.text: Dimas spoke confidently in front of the judges.

choices.say: Dimas spoke confidently in front of the judges.

visual.text: Dimas spoke confident in front of the judges.

choices.say: Dimas spoke confident in front of the judges.

visual.text: Dimas spoke confidence in front of the judges.

choices.say: Dimas spoke confidence in front of the judges.

visual.text: Dimas spoke confide in front of the judges.

choices.say: Dimas spoke confide in front of the judges.

items.reteach: Verb "spoke" diterangkan adverb: confidently.

items.prompt: Which part is kurang tepat? "The (A) government made an (B) announce that all (C) schools would (D) close early."
items.reteach: Setelah "an" diperlukan noun: announcement, bukan verb "announce".

items.prompt: Which part is kurang tepat? "The tourists were very (A) happiness with the (B) beautiful view (C) of (D) Bromo."
items.reteach: Setelah "were very" diperlukan adjective: happy, bukan noun "happiness".

items.prompt: Choose the sentence in which every word form is correct.

visual.text: Her kindness made the new student feel welcome.

choices.say: Her kindness made the new student feel welcome.

visual.text: Her kindly made the new student feel welcome.

choices.say: Her kindly made the new student feel welcome.

visual.text: Her kindness made the new student feel welcomely.

choices.say: Her kindness made the new student feel welcomely.

visual.text: Her kind made the new student feel welcomely.

choices.say: Her kind made the new student feel welcomely.

items.reteach: Subjek "Her ___" perlu noun (kindness); setelah "feel" perlu adjective (welcome).

items.prompt: Which part is kurang tepat? "The (A) unhonest seller (B) cheated his (C) customers (D) repeatedly."
items.reteach: Lawan kata honest memakai prefix dis-: dishonest, bukan "unhonest".

items.prompt: Which part is kurang tepat? "Please (A) reread the text (B) careful and (C) underline the (D) main ideas."
items.reteach: Verb "reread" diterangkan adverb: carefully.

items.prompt: Which part is kurang tepat? "Many people (A) disagree with the (B) decision because it seems (C) unfairly to (D) farmers."
items.reteach: Setelah linking verb "seems" dipakai adjective: unfair.

items.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about the lost wallet.

visual.text: It is impossible to find the wallet in this crowd.

choices.say: It is impossible to find the wallet in this crowd.

visual.text: It is unpossible to find the wallet in this crowd.

choices.say: It is unpossible to find the wallet in this crowd.

visual.text: It is dispossible to find the wallet in this crowd.

choices.say: It is dispossible to find the wallet in this crowd.

visual.text: It is inpossible to find the wallet in this crowd.

choices.say: It is inpossible to find the wallet in this crowd.

items.reteach: Lawan kata possible adalah impossible (prefix im- sebelum huruf p).

items.prompt: Which part is kurang tepat? "The (A) teacher praised our (B) creative and (C) usefull (D) presentation."
items.reteach: Suffix -ful hanya memakai satu l: useful.

items.prompt: Which part is kurang tepat? "After the (A) heavy rain, the road became (B) slippery, so drivers had to brake (C) gentle and (D) carefully."
items.reteach: Verb "brake" diterangkan adverb: gently (sejajar dengan "carefully").

items.prompt: Choose the sentence that uses the word "misunderstand" correctly.

visual.text: I think you misunderstood my message; I meant Tuesday, not Thursday.

choices.say: I think you misunderstood my message; I meant Tuesday, not Thursday.

visual.text: I think you were misunderstand my message; I meant Tuesday, not Thursday.

choices.say: I think you were misunderstand my message; I meant Tuesday, not Thursday.

visual.text: I think you misunderstanded my message; I meant Tuesday, not Thursday.

choices.say: I think you misunderstanded my message; I meant Tuesday, not Thursday.

visual.text: I think you unmisunderstood my message; I meant Tuesday, not Thursday.

choices.say: I think you unmisunderstood my message; I meant Tuesday, not Thursday.

items.reteach: Misunderstand memakai bentuk lampau tidak beraturan: misunderstood.

items.prompt: Which part is kurang tepat? "Her (A) happiness was (B) obvious when she (C) succeed in the (D) competition."
items.reteach: Kalimat lampau ("was") memerlukan verb lampau: succeeded.

items.prompt: Which part is kurang tepat? "The (A) movement of the dancers was (B) graceful, and the (C) audience clapped (D) enthusiastic."
items.reteach: Verb "clapped" diterangkan adverb: enthusiastically.

items.prompt: In the notice about the farewell ceremony, what part of speech is "renovation"?

stimulus.text: NOTICE: Due to the renovation of the school hall, the farewell ceremony will be held on the sports field. Students are kindly requested to arrive punctually at 7.00 a.m.

items.reteach: "The renovation of" — setelah "the" ada noun. Akhiran -tion membentuk noun.

items.prompt: In the farewell ceremony notice, the word "punctually" is closest in meaning to …

stimulus.text: NOTICE: Due to the renovation of the school hall, the farewell ceremony will be held on the sports field. Students are kindly requested to arrive punctually at 7.00 a.m.

items.reteach: Punctually = tepat waktu (adverb dari punctual).

items.prompt: Why will the ceremony in the notice be held on the sports field?

stimulus.text: NOTICE: Due to the renovation of the school hall, the farewell ceremony will be held on the sports field. Students are kindly requested to arrive punctually at 7.00 a.m.

visual.text: The school hall is being renovated.

choices.say: The school hall is being renovated.

visual.text: The hall is too far away.

choices.say: The hall is too far away.

items.reteach: "Due to the renovation of the school hall" menunjukkan alasannya.

items.prompt: In the text about Pak Harto, the word "creations" comes from the verb …

stimulus.text: Pak Harto is a skilful potter in Malang. He shapes clay patiently, and his creations are admired by collectors. His success shows that patience brings rewards.

items.reteach: create (verb) + -ion = creation (noun). Creative adalah adjective, creator adalah orangnya.

items.prompt: In the text about Pak Harto, which word is an adverb?

stimulus.text: Pak Harto is a skilful potter in Malang. He shapes clay patiently, and his creations are admired by collectors. His success shows that patience brings rewards.

items.reteach: "Patiently" menerangkan verb "shapes", jadi adverb.

items.prompt: What is the main message of the text about Pak Harto?

stimulus.text: Pak Harto is a skilful potter in Malang. He shapes clay patiently, and his creations are admired by collectors. His success shows that patience brings rewards.

visual.text: Working patiently can lead to success.

choices.say: Working patiently can lead to success.

items.reteach: Kalimat terakhir: "patience brings rewards" — kesabaran membawa hasil.

items.prompt: In the text about Sinta, the word "hopeless" means she felt …

stimulus.text: Sinta felt hopeless after losing the first round. Her coach encouraged her, and she played more aggressively in the second round. Finally, she won the match.

items.reteach: Suffix -less = tanpa: hopeless = putus asa.

items.prompt: In the text about Sinta, the adverb "aggressively" describes how Sinta …

stimulus.text: Sinta felt hopeless after losing the first round. Her coach encouraged her, and she played more aggressively in the second round. Finally, she won the match.

items.reteach: Adverb menerangkan verb di dekatnya: "played more aggressively".

items.prompt: What can we infer from the text about Sinta?

stimulus.text: Sinta felt hopeless after losing the first round. Her coach encouraged her, and she played more aggressively in the second round. Finally, she won the match.

visual.text: Her coach's support helped her win.

choices.say: Her coach's support helped her win.

visual.text: She stopped playing after the first round.

choices.say: She stopped playing after the first round.

items.reteach: Setelah didorong pelatih, Sinta bermain lebih agresif dan menang.

items.prompt: In the word-family table, which word belongs in place of "? (1)"?
items.reteach: Kolom Adjective: attract → attractive (seperti protect → protective).

items.prompt: In the word-family table, which word belongs in place of "? (2)"?
items.reteach: Kolom Noun: inform → information (seperti create → creation).

items.prompt: Which sentence uses a word from the "Adjective" column of the table correctly?

visual.text: The new park is attractive to tourists.

choices.say: The new park is attractive to tourists.

visual.text: The new park is attraction to tourists.

choices.say: The new park is attraction to tourists.

visual.text: The new park is attractively to tourists.

choices.say: The new park is attractively to tourists.

items.reteach: Setelah "is" dipakai adjective: attractive.

items.prompt: A: "Did you enjoy the Reog performance in Ponorogo?" B: "Yes! The dancers moved so ___."
items.reteach: Verb "moved" diterangkan adverb: energetically.

items.prompt: A: "Why did Raka lose points in the essay contest?" B: "His ideas were good, but his handwriting was almost ___."
items.reteach: "But" menunjukkan kekurangan: unreadable = tidak bisa dibaca.

items.prompt: A: "Mom, I broke your favourite cup. I'm sorry." B: "That's all right. It was an ___; you didn't do it on purpose."
items.reteach: Setelah "an" diperlukan noun tunggal: accident.

items.prompt: A: "What do you want to be in the future?" B: "I want to be a ___ and design apps for farmers."
items.reteach: Setelah "a" untuk menyebut orang: developer (suffix -er = pelaku).

items.prompt: A: "How was the trip to Ijen crater?" B: "Amazing, but climbing at 2 a.m. was really ___. I could hardly breathe."
items.reteach: Adjective -ing menjelaskan hal yang menyebabkan perasaan: climbing was exhausting.

items.prompt: A: "Why didn't you come to the meeting?" B: "Sorry, I ___ the time. I thought it started at 4, not at 2."
items.reteach: mis- = keliru: misread = keliru membaca.

items.prompt: A: "Is the water from this well safe?" B: "Not yet. You have to boil it first before it is ___."
items.reteach: Suffix -able = bisa: drinkable = bisa diminum.

items.prompt: A: "I can't find my phone anywhere!" B: "Stay calm. Let's search every room ___."
items.reteach: Verb "search" diterangkan adverb: systematically.

items.prompt: A: "Why are you so happy, Ayu?" B: "My ___ to the science camp in Batu was accepted!"
items.reteach: Setelah "My" diperlukan noun: application (pendaftaran).

items.prompt: A: "Our team lost again." B: "Don't feel ___. We played better than last time."
items.reteach: Setelah "feel" dipakai adjective -ed untuk perasaan: discouraged (patah semangat).

items.prompt: A: "Do you trust that online seller?" B: "Not really. Some reviews say he was ___."
items.reteach: Setelah "was" diperlukan adjective: dishonest (tidak jujur).

items.prompt: Teacher: "What is the difference between the two words?" Student: "'Careful' means full of care, while 'careless' means ___."
items.reteach: -ful = penuh, -less = tanpa.

items.prompt: A: "This box of books is too heavy for me." B: "Let me help. I'll carry it ___ you."
items.reteach: Preposition "for" berarti untuk/menggantikan seseorang: carry it for you.

items.prompt: Arrange the words into a correct sentence: "carefully / the / read / instructions / students / the"

visual.text: The students read the instructions carefully.

choices.say: The students read the instructions carefully.

visual.text: The students carefully the instructions read.

choices.say: The students carefully the instructions read.

visual.text: The instructions read the students carefully.

choices.say: The instructions read the students carefully.

visual.text: Carefully the read students the instructions.

choices.say: Carefully the read students the instructions.

items.reteach: Pola: Subject + Verb + Object + adverb of manner.

items.prompt: Rewrite "Rina decided quickly" using the noun "decision". Which is correct?
items.reteach: Noun "decision" diterangkan adjective (quick); kolokasinya "make a decision".

items.prompt: Transform "The guide explained the history clearly" into a sentence with the noun "explanation".

visual.text: The guide gave a clear explanation of the history.

choices.say: The guide gave a clear explanation of the history.

visual.text: The guide gave a clearly explanation of the history.

choices.say: The guide gave a clearly explanation of the history.

visual.text: The guide explanation the history clearly.

choices.say: The guide explanation the history clearly.

visual.text: The guide gave a clear explain of the history.

choices.say: The guide gave a clear explain of the history.

items.reteach: Adverb "clearly" menjadi adjective "clear" saat menerangkan noun "explanation".

items.prompt: Which sentence has the same meaning as "It is not possible to finish the bridge this year"?

visual.text: It is impossible to finish the bridge this year.

choices.say: It is impossible to finish the bridge this year.

visual.text: It is unpossible to finish the bridge this year.

choices.say: It is unpossible to finish the bridge this year.

visual.text: It is possibly to finish the bridge this year.

choices.say: It is possibly to finish the bridge this year.

visual.text: It is disposable to finish the bridge this year.

choices.say: It is disposable to finish the bridge this year.

items.reteach: not possible = impossible (prefix im-).

items.prompt: Arrange the words: "very / a / gave / speech / the / principal / inspiring"

visual.text: The principal gave a very inspiring speech.

choices.say: The principal gave a very inspiring speech.

visual.text: The principal gave a speech very inspiring.

choices.say: The principal gave a speech very inspiring.

visual.text: The principal gave very a inspiring speech.

choices.say: The principal gave very a inspiring speech.

visual.text: A very principal gave the inspiring speech.

choices.say: A very principal gave the inspiring speech.

items.reteach: Urutan frasa benda: article + adverb + adjective + noun (a very inspiring speech).

items.prompt: Rewrite "Dimas is a fast swimmer" using the verb "swim".
items.reteach: "Fast" sebagai adverb tetap "fast" (tidak ada "fastly"); subjek tunggal memakai "swims".

items.prompt: Change "The answer is correct" into the opposite meaning by adding a prefix.
items.reteach: Lawan kata correct memakai prefix in-: incorrect.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: "beautifully / in / sang / the / Ayu / hall"

visual.text: Ayu sang beautifully in the hall.

choices.say: Ayu sang beautifully in the hall.

visual.text: Ayu beautifully sang the in hall.

choices.say: Ayu beautifully sang the in hall.

visual.text: In Ayu the hall sang beautifully.

choices.say: In Ayu the hall sang beautifully.

visual.text: Ayu sang in beautifully the hall.

choices.say: Ayu sang in beautifully the hall.

items.reteach: Pola: Subject + Verb + adverb of manner + keterangan tempat.

items.prompt: Rewrite "The tourists were amazed by the sunrise at Bromo" using the noun "amazement".

visual.text: The tourists watched the sunrise at Bromo in amazement.

choices.say: The tourists watched the sunrise at Bromo in amazement.

visual.text: The tourists amazement the sunrise at Bromo.

choices.say: The tourists amazement the sunrise at Bromo.

visual.text: The tourists watched the sunrise at Bromo in amazing.

choices.say: The tourists watched the sunrise at Bromo in amazing.

visual.text: The tourists were amazement by the sunrise at Bromo.

choices.say: The tourists were amazement by the sunrise at Bromo.

items.reteach: Noun dipakai setelah preposition: in amazement (dengan takjub).

items.prompt: Change "He speaks with confidence" into "He is a ___ speaker". Which sentence is correct?
items.reteach: Sebelum noun "speaker" diperlukan adjective: confident.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: "the / was / of / improvement / students / remarkable / the"

visual.text: The improvement of the students was remarkable.

choices.say: The improvement of the students was remarkable.

visual.text: The students of the improvement was remarkable.

choices.say: The students of the improvement was remarkable.

visual.text: Remarkable the improvement was of the students.

choices.say: Remarkable the improvement was of the students.

visual.text: The improvement was the students of remarkable.

choices.say: The improvement was the students of remarkable.

items.reteach: Subjek "The improvement of the students" + was + adjective "remarkable".

items.prompt: Change "The road is not safe at night" by using a prefix, keeping the same meaning.

visual.text: The road is unsafe at night.

choices.say: The road is unsafe at night.

visual.text: The road is dissafe at night.

choices.say: The road is dissafe at night.

visual.text: The road is insafe at night.

choices.say: The road is insafe at night.

visual.text: The road is missafe at night.

choices.say: The road is missafe at night.

items.reteach: not safe = unsafe (prefix un-).

items.prompt: Rewrite "Sinta is very kind" using the noun "kindness".
items.reteach: Setelah possessive (Sinta's) diperlukan noun: kindness.

items.prompt: Analogy: happy : happiness = weak : ___
items.reteach: Adjective + -ness = noun: happiness, weakness.

items.prompt: Analogy: decide : decision = conclude : ___
items.reteach: Verb → noun dengan -sion: decision, conclusion. Conclusive adalah adjective.

items.prompt: Which word is the odd one out because it is a different part of speech? quickly, gently, friendly, loudly
items.reteach: Friendly adalah adjective; tiga lainnya adverb.

items.prompt: Which word is the odd one out by the meaning of its prefix? unhappy, dishonest, impolite, rewrite
items.reteach: re- berarti lagi; un-, dis-, im- berarti tidak.

items.prompt: Riddle: I am a suffix. Add me to "help", "hope", and "use", and they lose what they had. What am I?
items.reteach: -less = tanpa: helpless, hopeless, useless.

items.prompt: Riddle: Put me before "understand", "spell", and "behave", and the action is done the incorrect way. Who am I?
items.reteach: mis- = keliru: misunderstand, misspell, misbehave.

items.prompt: Code: NOUN = 1, VERB = 2, ADJECTIVE = 3, ADVERB = 4. Ignoring "Her", what is the code for "Her brave sister swam quickly"?
items.reteach: brave (adjective) – sister (noun) – swam (verb) – quickly (adverb).

items.prompt: Which base word can take BOTH the prefix "un-" and the suffix "-able" to make a real word?
items.reteach: un + believ(e) + able = unbelievable.

items.prompt: Word chain: act → action → active → ___ (adverb)
items.reteach: Adjective active + -ly = actively (adverb).

items.prompt: Which letter completes all three words of the same family? "em_loy – em_loyment – em_loyer"
items.reteach: employ, employment, employer.

items.prompt: Analogy: teach : teacher = ___ : visitor
items.reteach: Verb + pelaku: teach → teacher, visit → visitor.

items.prompt: How many of these words are nouns? kindness, kindly, kind-hearted, unkindness
items.reteach: Noun: kindness dan unkindness. Kindly bisa adverb/adjective, kind-hearted adjective.

items.prompt: Find the odd one out by the meaning of "-er": teacher, singer, driver, taller
items.reteach: Pada taller, -er membentuk comparative; pada kata lain -er menyebut pelaku.

items.prompt: Which word does NOT form a real noun with the suffix "-ment"?
items.reteach: enjoyment, agreement, development ada; untuk happy noun-nya happiness.
